Initial web response not byte-captured; normalized all-paper inventory and explicit approximate minute timestamp preserved. Later formal web raw response is preserved.

Six dated arXiv query families yield no direct STU/open-set paper; one broad benchmark hit is construction-site traversability. This is a query-bounded coverage gap, not proof that no new road anomaly paper exists.

Parent owns local corpus, complete October listings and existing-report revision checks. This shard uses original submission-date overlap, not announcement-date classification.
